violations.text: The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was (400) parts per million (ppm). PIC refilled sanitizer to correct ppm. According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be (200) ppm. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

The pre-flush spray hose at the (3-bay sink) is hanging below the flood rim. A plumbing system shall be installed to prevent backflow of a liquid or gas contaminant into the water supply by providing an air gap or installing an approved backflow prevention device. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

The floor underneath shelf, beverage dispenser, and on side of mops sink has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

The door to the outside, located in the left side of main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/27/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice dispenser have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2025
The prep sink was observed to be leaking from top faucet. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 03/07/2024
